meta_title: Smile First Pediatric Dentistry | Children's dentist in Rocky Point, NY
meta_desc: Pediatric and general dentistry in Rocky Point and Oakdale, NY. One practice for toddlers, teens and the adults in the family.
hero_h1: Pediatric dentistry in Rocky Point, NY
hero_sub: Smile First and Smile Shack are now one practice, caring for toddlers through to adults.
about_heading: One practice for toddlers through adults
about_body:
Smile First Pediatric Dentistry was built around children, and that has not changed. Dr. Viet Tran and Dr. Victoria Shack have brought Smile First and Smile Shack together so one practice can care for the whole family.

The dentist your toddler meets can still be their dentist as a teenager, and can look after you as well. Appointments are available in Rocky Point and in Oakdale.

services.name: Pediatric dentistry
services.blurb: Dental care shaped around children, from first visits to growing teeth.

services.name: Toddlers and young children
services.blurb: Gentle early appointments that help small children get comfortable in the chair.

services.name: Teen dental care
services.blurb: Care that continues through the teenage years without changing practice.

services.name: General dentistry for adults
services.blurb: Parents can now be seen at the same practice as their children.
